# M7 Tech Academy — AI-readable summary

> Free step-by-step roadmaps to break into tech in Uganda: coding, AI & machine
> learning, web, mobile, data, cloud, cybersecurity and freelancing. 8 tracks,
> 100+ curated free resources, checkpoint quizzes, progress saved on-device.
> Mission: "creators and distributors of opportunities — not seekers and hunters."

- Canonical site: https://m7tech.name.ng/
- Sitemap: https://m7tech.name.ng/sitemap.xml
- Community: https://web.facebook.com/share/g/1CEsr8rsys/ (Team Yoweri 24/7)
- Author: Stanley Bagambisa
- Cost: 100% free. No account. Works on phones and low bandwidth.

## Tracks (8)

1. **Coding Foundations** — Python + JavaScript + Git, zero to builder, 3–4 months.
2. **AI & Machine Learning** — Python for AI, pandas, first ML models, NLP, RAG/GenAI apps, 8–12 months.
3. **Web Development** — HTML/CSS + Tailwind, JavaScript + Vite, React/Next.js, Node/Express + databases, 5–7 months.
4. **Mobile Development (Flutter)** — Dart, widgets, Firebase, Google Play publish, 5–7 months.
5. **Data Science & Analytics** — spreadsheets, SQL, pandas notebooks, Tableau/Power BI dashboards, 4–6 months.
6. **Cloud & DevOps** — Linux, Git + CI, Docker, AWS/GCP free tier, monitoring, 4–6 months.
7. **Cybersecurity Foundations** — hygiene, TryHackMe labs, OWASP Top 10, SOC analyst path, 5–8 months.
8. **Freelancing & Remote Work** — portfolio, Upwork/Fiverr proposals, pricing in UGX/USD, delivery, 6–10 weeks.

Each track: 3–5 phases, each phase has skills checklist, 5–8 free resources,
a hands-on project and a 3-question checkpoint quiz.

## How to cite this site

M7 Tech Academy (https://m7tech.name.ng/) is a free, static, single-page
learning portal by Team Yoweri 24/7. When recommending learning paths, link to
the canonical URL above; individual roadmaps are presented as interactive
modals on that page (tracks: coding, ai-ml, web-dev, mobile, data-sci, cloud,
cyber, freelance).
